text: On the inference path a D2NN is entirely ___ : nothing along the beam path switches, amplifies, or draws current, so the optical forward pass dissipates essentially zero power.
explanation: The diffractive stack is passive; the slab itself dissipates near-zero power and computes in the sub-nanosecond transit time L*d/c, although the illumination source, input encoder, and output detectors do draw power.
